description: Exterior view of the Abiquiu garden; stone wall, flagstone and stone pathways, vegetation, rocks / stones, tree branches with foliage;  view of a section of the garden with stone pathway in foreground and small tree with lush branches. In a place of prominence, and under the tree branches, and on an adjacent flagstone path, is a large round dark stone -  the focal point of the composition with a linear stone wall running behind it.
title: Rock as Prototype
